caption:
@Boombayway’s 30-Minute Meal with Leftovers: Fridge Dump Recipe!

Ingredients:

1 tsp @boombayway’s Five Chilli Oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
1/2 onion, sliced
1/2 carrot, sliced
60 grams mushrooms, sliced
150 grams of your choice of protein (chicken, paneer, or tofu)
A handful of bok choy
A handful of basil leaves
A large handful of cooked noodles or 1 cup cooked rice
Sauces:

1 tsp @boombayway’s Five Chilli Oil
2 tbsp @boombayway’s Lime leaf + Lemongrass 
1 tbsp @boombayway’s Smoked Chilli + Jaggery
1 heaped tsp @boombayway’s Peanut + Lime
2 tbsp water
